steps.en: Install the wheel — the MuPDF C engine is bundled inside
steps.zh: 装 wheel，MuPDF C 引擎已打包在内

steps.en: Parses the file in-process with MuPDF and exposes its pages
steps.zh: 在进程内用 MuPDF 解析文件，交出各个页面

steps.en: Ask each page for text with layout metadata
steps.zh: 向每一页要带版式信息的文本

steps.en: Returns blocks, lines and spans with font, size and bounding box
steps.zh: 返回块、行、片段，附字体、字号和边框坐标

value.en: Fast, offline extraction with exact positions — and the same object can render, redact, merge and save
value.zh: 快速、离线、坐标精确的提取，同一个对象还能渲染、涂黑、合并、保存

sources: https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF#installation (pip install pymupdf; wheels, no mandatory dependencies)
